headline: The Bull Case For Target (TGT) Could Change Following Digital Pivot Amid Legal And Product Shifts – Learn Why
summary: In recent weeks, Target Corporation was named as a product seller in a Washington State infant botulism lawsuit linked to recalled Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Infant Formula, while also adding former 7-Eleven CEO Joe DePinto to its Board and preparing to carry Final Boss Sour products this fall. Alongside these developments, Target has been emphasizing the growth of its interconnected digital ecosystem, spanning same-day services, memberships, advertising, and marketplace offerings,...
